programme.title: 10 Items or Less
programme.desc: Oscar®-vinnaren Morgan Freeman spelar här en filmstjärna som ger sig ut på rollförberedande research i ett snabbköp i Los Angeles. Han möter en snabbtalande kassörska och de ger sig av på en gemensam resa för att visa varandra sina respektive världar.

programme.title: Fast Girls
programme.desc: En gatsmart sprintertjej får en bitter rival i sin minst lika ambitiösa men rikare lagkamrat i detta sexiga, kaxiga, vilda och fartfyllda drama med massor av romantik, konflikter och den nervpirrande jakten på guldet.

programme.title: White Oleander
programme.desc: I ett anfall av sjuklig svartsjuka förgiftar den kompromisslösa och förföriska konstnären Ingrid sin älskare. Hon döms till livstids fängelse och hennes 15-åriga dotter Astrid får därefter flytta runt mellan olika fosterfamiljer.

programme.title: Get Rich or Die Tryin'
programme.desc: Efter en eldstrid med nästan dödlig utgång, minns Marcus sin resa från föräldralös rännstensunge i Bronx till framgångsrik knarkhandlare, och hans partnerskap med en gammal fängelsekompis (Terrence Howard) i ett försök att bli framgångsrik rapartist.

programme.title: The FBI Files: John Gotti: Convicted
programme.desc: John Gotti was ambitious, powerful and ruthless. He ruled with flash and conspicuous style, playing celebrity with the media and cat and mouse with the FBI. They called John Gotti the Teflon Don. Serious charges just wouldn't stick.

programme.title: The FBI Files
programme.desc: From California to Kentucky, few living near a railroad felt safe in the summer of 1999. A serial killer, rode the rails, picking towns and victims at random. He left behind a trail of bloodshed, but no trace of where he would turn up next.

programme.title: The FBI Files
programme.desc: In Las Vegas, a gang of robbers target an ATM repository and hit the jackpot. Their take was over a million dollars in cash, the largest heist in Las Vegas history.

programme.title: The FBI Files: Millionaire Murder
programme.desc: A businessman went to Florida to make one last deal before he retired-he never returned home to his millions. Authorities examined who was closest to him and who stood to gain from his disappearance. But this time conventional rules didn't apply.

programme.title: Kalla mig Dave
programme.desc: Det är inte för att han är besvärlig, blyg eller klädd i discokläder som Dave Ming Chang sticker ut i New York. Det beror på att han är en utomjording! Närmare bestämt ett utomjordiskt rymdskepp...

programme.title: How to Be
programme.desc: Art (Robert Pattinson) blir dumpad av flickvännen och flyttar tillbaka hem till mamma och pappa och hamnar i en 25-årskris. Art lägger sitt arv på inköp och new age-terapi och tar så småningom även hjälp av en excentrisk själv-hjälps-guru, Dr Ellington.

programme.title: The Female Brain
programme.desc: Den faktaorienterade neuroforskaren Julias forskning om hur den kvinnliga och den manliga hjärnan fungerar illustreras med hjälp av tre olika par. Men Julias fasta övertygelse utmanas när en stilig ny försöksperson deltar i hennes försök…

programme.title: Being Mary Jane: Blindsided
programme.desc: Mary Jane blir förtvivlad när en av henne intervjuer leder till självmord. Samtidigt hamnar Mark i en obekväm sits. Niecy är rädd att Dante inte dyker upp på förlossningen och Patrick ifrågasätter Helens vård.

programme.title: Being Mary Jane: Uber Love
programme.desc: I sista avsnittet av första säsongen konfronteras Mary Jane med de personer hon sårat. Och Lisa och Mary Janes vänskap sätts på prov.

programme.title: Being Mary Jane: People In Glass Houses Shouldn't Throw Fish
programme.desc: Mary Jane har middag och bjuder in ett gift par som hon och David brukade umgås med som par. Hon börjar även fundera på vad hon vill ha ut av livet efter att ha fått reda på att Davids nya flickvän är gravid.

programme.title: Boomerang: Us Too
programme.desc: MeToo-rörelsen blir påtaglig när det framkommer anklagelser mot Marcus Graham, och The Graham Agency stänger för gott. Efteråt får gänget trösta Simone och sen varandra.

programme.title: Boomerang: Trust
programme.desc: Gänget firar Aris födelsedag. Simone blir förvirrad när Camden dyker upp och äventyrar hennes förhållande med Bryson.

programme.title: Boomerang: There U Go
programme.desc: Gänget gör sig klara för Homecoming, vissa med sex i åtanke, och det blir tydligt hur alla har förändrats eller inte efter Simones och Brysons uppbrott.

programme.title: Boomerang: Love Shoulda Brought You Home
programme.desc: Alla berättar sin version av vad som hände när Simone och Bryson gjorde slut, vilket avslöjar vad de tycker om varandra och prövar deras lojalitet.

programme.title: Games People Play: Persons of Interests
programme.desc: Loomis ser Cooper vid en Vipersmatch. Cooper tvingas lämna ifrån sig övervakningsfilmen från bråket mellan Vanessa och Kalinda. Hon erbjuder sig att lämna in den för att behålla jobbet, men får sparken när hon gör det.

programme.title: Games People Play: A Wing and A Prayer
programme.desc: Laila hamnar i en farlig situation. MJ hör rykten om att nån läcker uppgifter om familjen King. Vanessas familj hotas och hon bestämmer att det är dags att agera.

programme.title: Melrose Place: Farväl, Mikes konkubin
programme.desc: Michael kampanjar för att bli nästa stabschef på Wilshire-sjukhuset, precis som Peter och den högpresterande överläkaren.

programme.title: Melrose Place: Bra jobbat om du får det
programme.desc: Jane åker till Chicago för att besöka sina föräldrar, men hon får en stor överraskning när hon råkar upptäcka att hon är adopterad.

programme.title: Melrose Place: Solosyster
programme.desc: Sydneys romans med Kyle gäckar henne när han säger att deras kärleksmöte på restaurangen endast var en engångsföreteelse.

programme.title: Melrose Place: Sökandet efter moder
programme.desc: Jane får äntligen träffa sin biologiska mamma, en mystisk före detta skådespelerska som inte är vem hon verkar. Craig hotar att avslöja en sen länge bevarad hemlighet.

programme.title: Melrose Place: Galen kärlek
programme.desc: Amanda övertalar Peter att gå till en terapeut efter att han blev galet svartsjuk och ställde till en scen på en affärsmiddag.

programme.title: Melrose Place: Den oavsiktliga läkaren
programme.desc: Under sitt födelsedagsfirande försöker Kyle få ihop Peter och Amanda igen, men kvällen driver dem bara längre isär.

programme.title: Doc Martin: Avsnitt 805
programme.desc: Martin och Louisa är desperata att få James att sluta bitas så de försöker med Mel´s förslag med bärnstenar.

programme.title: Doc Martin: Avsnitt 806
programme.desc: Penhale bestämmer att polisen ska ha öppet hus för att skapa medvetenhet i kommunen men det blir inte som han tänkt. Morwenna lämnar kirurgiavdelningen för en helg tillsammans med Al.

programme.title: Doc Martin: Avsnitt 807
programme.desc: Det är dags för den årliga roddtävlingen mellan Portwenn och Port Carran och Morwenna behöver hitta en ersättare.

programme.title: Doc Martin: Avsnitt 808
programme.desc: Martin har inte kunnat jobba vilket inte har hindrat patienter att be om medicinska råd.

programme.title: Doc Martin: Avsnitt 201
programme.desc: Louisas gamla kärlek, Danny Steel, kommer till Portwenn för att försöka återuppväcka deras romans. Han blir vansinnig på Martin när han blandar sig i hans mammas flytt till ett äldreboende.

programme.title: Doc Martin: Avsnitt 202
programme.desc: När hans mor måste till sjukhuset, behöver Peter Cronk någonstans att bo. Doktorn är inte speciellt förtjust i detta, men Louise är upptagen med sin ansökan till rektorstjänsten.

programme.title: Wildfire: Impressions
programme.desc: Kris and Junior are getting more serious as Junior invites Kris to have dinner with the Davis'.

programme.title: Wildfire: Loyalty
programme.desc: Kris is hired to ride Wildfire although she struggles to remain focused because of her relationship with Junior.

programme.title: Wildfire: Try It Without The Porsche
programme.desc: Kris meets Kerry Connelly, a sports agent who takes interest in Kris after the results of the Sandpiper Race.

programme.title: Wildfire: Opportunity Knocks
programme.desc: On the heels of her dramatic second place finish in the Sandpiper Race, Kris is offered an opportunity to star in a commercial with Wildfire, which unexpectedly thrusts Kris and Junior together.

programme.title: Wildfire: A Good Convict Is Hard To Find
programme.desc: Kris reluctantly returns to Camp LaGrange for an event at the Equestrian Center where she first met Wildfire.

programme.title: Wildfire: Dangerous Liaisons
programme.desc: Kris is left alone in charge of Raintree when Jean goes on a trip with Charlie, Matt goes with Dani to help her look into a new racehorse, and Pablo investigates a mysterious phone call.

programme.title: Honest Thief
programme.desc: I sin jakt på att leva ett ärligt liv, lämnar bankrånaren Tom över sig till polisen. Men han inser snart att de är mer korrupt än han själv och för att rentvå sitt namn måste han nu slå tillbaka.

programme.title: Hot Seat
programme.desc: IT-experten Friar hittar en bomb med tryckkänslig utlösare under sin skrivbordsstol och en osynlig hackare tvingar honom att stjäla digitala medel på nätet – för annars kommer Friars dotter att föras bort.

programme.title: Lucky Number Slevin
programme.desc: När en person förlorar sin identitet, råkar Slevin hamna i en konflikt mellan två av stadens största brottslingar och han övervakas nu av både polisen och den ökände yrkesmördaren Goodkat.

programme.title: On the Twelfth Day of Christmas
programme.desc: Maggie blir överlycklig när hon får reda på att hennes gamla förälskelse ska flytta tillbaka till staden där hon bor.

programme.title: Much Ado About Christmas
programme.desc: Efter att Haley Lloyd har blivit sviken av otaliga friare är det uppfriskande när den blyge men stilige Claud faller för henne, ovetandes om hennes sanna identitet.

programme.title: How Sarah got her wings
programme.desc: Den goda samariten Sarah Fitzpatrick dör i en olycka strax före jul och befinner sig plötsligt vid himlens portar. Hon är säker på att hon ska bli insläppt, men hennes namn finns inte med på listan.

programme.title: Paterson
programme.desc: Paterson (Adam Driver) är busschaufför i staden Paterson, New Jersey. Varje dag kör han sin dagliga rutt under vilken han observerar staden när den flimrar förbi genom vindrutan och lyssnar samtidigt på fragment av passagerarnas konversationer.

programme.title: Modern Persuasion
programme.desc: En modern version av Jane Austens roman ”Övertalning”. En singelkvinna med totalt fokus på sin karriär i New York tvingas förhålla sig till följderna av en kraschad relation när hennes ex anlitar firman där hon jobbar.

programme.title: Can You Keep a Secret?
programme.desc: Emma sitter på ett plan som hon tror är på väg att störta. Hon berättar därför alla sina hemligheter för en snygg främling. Åtminstone tror hon att han är en främling...tills hon träffar Jack, hennes företags nya vd. Baserad på romanen med samma namn.

programme.title: The Coed and the Zombie Stoner
programme.desc: When a nerdy sorority girl falls in love with a zombie, it's only a matter of time before a zombie apocalypse is unleashed on campus. The sorority girl discovers that weed is the cure--now she must smoke out the entire school before it's too late.

programme.title: After the Lethargy
programme.desc: Journalisten Sara reser till en plats där det sägs finnas utomjordingar. Hon och hennes guide attackeras och tvingas söka skydd i en övergiven militäranläggning djupt inne i urskogen.

programme.title: The Dead Zone: Panic
programme.desc: When Johnny, J.J. and a neighbourhood teen are trapped inside the Smith home by two ruthless killers, Johnny's visions of the past help them evade capture.

programme.title: The Twilight Zone: Five Characters in Search of an Exit
programme.desc: A hobo, clown, bagpipe player, ballerina and military officer are trapped in a huge cylinder.

programme.title: The Twilight Zone: The Fugitive
programme.desc: Old Ben, who is able to transform himself into anything, tries to help a crippled little girl.

programme.title: The Dead Zone: Broken Circle
programme.desc: Johnny (Anthony Michael Hall) fights to stop Rebecca (Sarah Wynter) from killing Greg Stillson (Sean Patrick Flanery), whom she believes is responsible for her sister's murder.

programme.title: Scorpion SV: Sci Hard
programme.desc: Under en tech-konferens tas Team Scorpion som gisslan av en grupp som försöker genomföra en virtuell stöld.

programme.title: Scorpion SV: Queen Scary
programme.desc: På Halloween tar Team Scorpion sig an ett fall för att bevisa att det finns spöken ombord på Queen Mary, men de råkar ut för en alltför verklig katastrof när de hittar ett "spökskepp" på en dödlig kollisionskurs.

programme.title: Scorpion SV: Go with the Flo(rence)
programme.desc: Medan Walter spårar en anordning som kan förhindra en kärnvapenkollaps genom Los Angeles kloaker lär han sig hur man lyssnar på Paige och hur man inte ger henne råd.

programme.title: Scorpion SV: Faire Is Foul
programme.desc: På Sylvesters födelsedag besöker team Scorpion en renässansfestival, men festligheterna avbryts när en grupp försöker råna ett närliggande bevisförvaringsskåp hos polisen.

programme.title: Scorpion SV: It's Raining Men (of War)
programme.desc: På Thanksgiving följer team Scorpions nya granne Florence med till sjöss på ett uppdrag att förstöra en flytande ö bestående av skräp.

programme.title: Scorpion SV: Crime Every Mountain
programme.desc: Medan Cabes rättegång hotar Team Scorpion, går ett enkelt fall i stöpet när de hjälper en far och hans dotter vars flygplan kraschat i närheten.

programme.title: Numb3rs
programme.desc: Don and his team must determine if a shooting on the freeway was a random act of violence or the work of a serial killer preying on the citizens of Los Angeles.

programme.title: Numb3rs
programme.desc: When a painting worth millions of dollars is stolen from a museum just before it is to go on tour, Don and his team must track down the thief, believing it is part of an insurance scam.

programme.title: Numb3rs
programme.desc: When an interpreter working for the Chinese consulate is killed in an apparent hit and run accident, Don and his team uncover an unlikely connection to the Department of Justice.

programme.title: Numb3rs
programme.desc: When Don and his team investigate a murder at a horse track, they stumble onto more than just a plot of betting on fixed races. Aya Sumika ("The O.C.") begins her recurring role as agent Liz Warner, Don's former trainee.

programme.title: Numb3rs
programme.desc: When a series of blackouts occur in power stations leaving Los Angeles in the dark, Don and his team must determine if it is an accident or the work of terrorists.

programme.title: Numb3rs
programme.desc: Don and his team investigate the death of a minor league baseball player to determine if it was an accidental overdose of steroids or a homicide.

programme.title: The Bells Of St Mary'S
programme.desc: At a big city Catholic school, Father O'Malley and Sister Benedict indulge in friendly rivalry, and succeed in extending the school through the gift of a building.

programme.title: Poupelle of Chimney Town
programme.desc: Poupelle från Chimney Town är berättelsen om den unge Lubicchi som lever bland den tjocka röken från skorstenarna i sin isolerade stad och längtar efter att se “stjärnorna” - att få veta sanningen - som hans far alltid berättat om för honom

programme.title: Legend of the Demon Cat
programme.desc: Filmen kommer från den BAFTA-prisbelönte regissören Chen Kaige och utspelar sig under Tangdynastin. En demonkatt dyker plötsligt upp och stör friden i staden Chang'an och orsakar en rad märkliga händelser.

programme.title: Star Trek III: The Search for Spock
programme.desc: Kirks triumf över Khan och skapandet av Genesisplaneten är tomma segrar. Spock är död och McCoy blir driven till vansinne. Ett besök av Sarek, Spocks far, avslöjar något chockerande: Spocks livsessens finns i McCoy.

programme.title: Star Trek V: The Final Frontier

programme.title: Forensic Files: Duelling Confessions
programme.desc: When Rosemary Anderson is found dead on the side of the road, her boyfriend becomes the prime suspect. He eventually confessed to her murder, but so did another man: serial killer Eric Edgar Cooke.

programme.title: Forensic Files: Traces of Truth
programme.desc: A mysterious computer crash pushed a thriving manufacturing company to the brink of collapse, jeopardizing hundreds of employees' jobs. Forensic investigators must determine if the crash was the result of a computer defect, human error or sabotage.

programme.title: Forensic Files: Deadly Curve
programme.desc: It was supposed to be a routine motorcade for the Queen of England. But on the way to Yosemite National Park, a car carrying three Secret Service agents collided with a car driven by a deputy from the local sheriff's office.

programme.title: Forensic Files: Visibility Zero
programme.desc: In 1993, the Amtrak Railroad experienced the deadliest train crash in United States history when the Sunset Limited derailed while crossing Alabama's Big Bayou Canot bridge. 47 passengers and crew were killed; scores more were injured.

programme.title: Forensic Files: Flashover
programme.desc: A fire erupts in Kings Cross Station in London, killing 31 people and injuring dozens more. Investigators pinpoint the cause of the fire, but it takes state-of-the-art technology and fluid dynamics experts to explain why it became a deadly inferno.

programme.title: Forensic Files: Hack Attack
programme.desc: A mysterious computer crash pushed a thriving manufacturing company to the brink of collapse, jeopardizing hundreds of jobs. Forensic investigators had to determine if the crash was the result of a computer defect, human error, or sabotage.

programme.title: Forensic Files: Road Rage
programme.desc: Police investigate a discarded sleeping bag containing bloody sneakers and a purse, which eventually leads to the body of a young woman. A mark found on the victim's body enables police to track the killer.

programme.title: Forensic Files: Hunter or Hunted
programme.desc: A woman is killed while walking her dogs in the woods. Since she has no enemies and her husband has an alibi, police assume it's a hunting accident — until they find a strange letter, allegedly written by the woman before her death.

programme.title: Forensic Files: In Harm's Way
programme.desc: An Alaskan police officer finds a woman's body while on routine patrol of a public park. During the autopsy, the medical examiner preserves the portion of her rib cage which sustained the fatal wound.

programme.title: Forensic Files: No Corpus Delicti
programme.desc: A woman disappears without a trace. Even though foul play is suspected, the leads don't pan out and the trail turns cold. Twenty years would pass before police are able to link a clump of hair discovered in an isolated area with the missing woman.

programme.title: Forensic Files: News at 11
programme.desc: When a talented television news anchor is shot to death outside her home, it appears to be a crime of passion perpetrated by an obsessed fan.

programme.title: The FBI Files: The World Trade Center Bombing
programme.desc: Terrorist bombings are what happen in other countries. Not here in the United States. And yet, in 1993, it happened in New York City.

programme.title: The FBI Files: John Gotti: Convicted
programme.desc: John Gotti was ambitious, powerful and ruthless. He ruled with flash and conspicuous style, playing celebrity with the media and cat and mouse with the FBI. They called John Gotti the Teflon Don. Serious charges just wouldn't stick.

programme.title: The FBI Files: The True Story of Mississippi Burning
programme.desc: Philadelphia, Mississippi, 1964. A sleepy southern town steeped in tradition finds itself targeted for invasion.

programme.title: The FBI Files: Polly Klaas: Kidnapped
programme.desc: On October 1, 1993, a stranger abducted 12-year-old Polly Klaas during a slumber party in her home.

programme.title: The FBI Files: Above the Law
programme.desc: California Highway Patrolman George Gwaltney discovered the body of 23-year-old Robin Bishop near her car on a remote desert highway.

programme.title: The New Detectives: Stolen Identity
programme.desc: When a theft is committed, something valuable is stolen. But when a criminal needs a new identity, theft becomes a matter of life and death.

programme.title: The New Detectives: Critical Evidence
programme.desc: To the astute detective and forensic specialist, the biggest clues often hide in plain sight, and what seems trivial to some is in reality Critical Evidence.

programme.title: The New Detectives: Grave Secrets
programme.desc: Killers often attempt to deflect attention away from their crimes by hiding the remains of their victims. Bodies may lay hidden for years before they are discovered.

programme.title: The New Detectives: Silent Killers
programme.desc: Weeks pass as forensic investigators search for even the smallest clues, only to find what they feared in their own backyard. In Canada, two people die suddenly of unknown causes, and their deaths may not be as coincidental as they first appear.

programme.title: The New Detectives: Flames Of Justice
programme.desc: Arson fires are set for their own sake, or to cover a different crime, such as murder. Think fire consumes all vital clues? Think again. Arson investigators can glean important clues from scorched rubble and ignite the unquenchable flames of justice.

programme.title: The Steve Wilkos Show: Look What You Did to Your Baby
programme.desc: Kristy wants her baby back from her mother Donna! Donna claims she took the baby away because he was born with severe disabilities due to Kristy’s drug use during pregnancy. Who’s the liar?

programme.title: The Steve Wilkos Show: Teen Mom Murderer?
programme.desc: At 17, Janelle's infant son died from serious injuries. She was sentenced to 3 years in prison for reckless homicide, but claims she's innocent. What will her polygraph results say?

programme.title: The Steve Wilkos Show: A Shocking Betrayal
programme.desc: Korey is positive that his girlfriend Dominique is cheating on him and is also worried that she might be selling sex. She says that his suspicions have caused him to become abusive. Then, Gregory thinks that his girlfriend Robin isn’t faithful!

programme.title: The Steve Wilkos Show: I Did It To Hurt You
programme.desc: Aeshia’s here to prove to Terrence and his wife Lashondra that Terrence is the father of her child, but Lashondra knows she’s wrong! Both Shaunah and Chris have convinced themselves that they’re being cheated on. Who’s the father?

programme.title: The Steve Wilkos Show: I Left You, But You Are The Father
programme.desc: Anastasia and Robert's 2 year relationship crumbled when he heard rumors that she was cheating on him. She says that she's always been faithful, but Robert doesn't believe her and now he doubts he is the father of her newborn baby.

programme.title: The Steve Wilkos Show: Did The Babysitter Abuse My Child?
programme.desc: Stephanie says that ever since she came home from work to find her 1-year-old with a black eye, she has feared that her children's babysitter harms them. Sitter Cheryl denies some serious accusations about a child.

programme.title: The Steve Wilkos Show: We Can't Live Like This
programme.desc: Thornton says he can't trust his cheating girlfriend Crystal and wants her to take a lie detector test! Plus, Stephanie wants to prove to her husband Mathew that she's not having sex with her own family member! She wants the accusations put to rest.

programme.title: Homicide Hunter: Shattered
programme.desc: When two teens discover a lifeless body in the street, Lt. Joe Kenda must determine if the killer was a jealous lover or just plain unhinged.

programme.title: Homicide Hunter: Hail of Bullets
programme.desc: The murder of a young father stuns his close-knit community, but the investigation reveals a neighborly dispute turned deadly.

programme.title: Homicide Hunter: The Master Key
programme.desc: When a pregnant mother and her two young sons are brutally slain, pressure mounts for the CSPD to catch the cold-blooded monster who did it.

programme.title: Homicide Hunter: Confession
programme.desc: After a husband and wife are viciously attacked in their own home, Kenda is on the hunt for a troubled teen whose appetite for violence knows no bounds.

programme.title: Homicide Hunter: Shallow Grave
programme.desc: Lt. Joe Kenda and his team investigate the scene of an apparent suicide, only to be forced to flee when they discover the house is booby-trapped.

programme.title: Nurses Who Kill: Elizabeth Wettlaufer
programme.desc: Wettlaufer, 49, of Ontario, intentionally administered fatal doses of drugs to her victims, aged 75 to 96, between 2007 and 2014. After killing, she would post some of her dozens of verses. Wettlaufer's victims included five women and three men.

programme.title: Nurses Who Kill: Efren Saldivar
programme.desc: Efren Saldivar confessed to killing 40 to 50 patients over an eight-year period. Quickly christened an "Angel of Death," he targeted patients who were already near death.

programme.title: Nurses Who Kill: Karen Pedley
programme.desc: The case of care home worker Karen Pedley who was given 14 life sentences in 2016. Deeply affected by a fire at her home when she was a child, Pedley developed into a pyromaniac.

programme.title: Nurses Who Kill: Sandra Weir
programme.desc: The story of Sandra Weir, who acted as a carer for her elderly neighbor. But she was stealing from the pensioner to fund her drug addiction, leading to a tragic confrontation.

programme.title: Nurses Who Kill: Paul Novak
programme.desc: The case of New York paramedic Paul Novak, who boasted of committing the perfect murder after the dust had settled on the death of his first wife Catherine.

programme.title: iCarly: Kvarsittning

programme.title: iCarly: Skoskav

programme.title: Trump: Power, Politics, Prosecution
programme.desc: En resa genom Donald Trumps politiska liv, hur han tog sig till makten, föll i onåd och fick ta konsekvenserna av sina kriminella handlingar.

programme.title: On the Case: Murder At Sunset- Part 2
programme.desc: A mother and two daughters are discovered floating in Tampa Bay after a brutal triple homicide. Police must rely on a victim who survived a similar attack to bring the killer to justice in this special two-hour On the Case.

programme.title: On the Case: This is for Her
programme.desc: A deadly home invasion leaves a father of three dead. Why was the victim's wife, the only eyewitness to the crime left alive?

programme.title: On the Case: Deep Wounds
programme.desc: After Navy electrician Michael Jacobs comes home to find his wife, Suzanne, and his three-year-old son, Colin, murdered, San Diego police race to catch a serial killer who leaves behind an unimaginable calling card.

programme.title: On the Case: Veil of Suspicion
programme.desc: A beloved husband and father is found executed in front of his home.

programme.title: On the Case: Blood Money
programme.desc: After 21 years, DNA analysis of a blood-stained dollar bill helps to solve the murder of gas station clerk Bradley Perry.

programme.title: On the Case: Unmistakable Truth
programme.desc: A family of three is murdered and investigators must take on one of their own in order to find justice.

programme.title: Ice Pilots NWT: Frozen Solid
programme.desc: AJ and James battle a DC-4 engine fire. It's Joe's 69th birthday - and he's never flown a helicopter before, so Mikey plans a special gift of chopper flight lessons.

programme.title: Ice Pilots NWT: Power Crash
programme.desc: Cory, Chuck and Brian watch as a 5,000-pound power unit smash to the ground, denting the Electra and putting it out of commission. Mikey scrambles to manage the crisis while Joe races to England to try and purchase a backup Electra.

programme.title: Ice Pilots NWT: Breakdown
programme.desc: Co-pilot Graeme's fumbles his Electra training landings. Chris stresses over his C-46 check ride. Adam rescues a stranded C-46.

programme.title: Ice Pilots NWT: Target Practice
programme.desc: Joe and Mikey head to England to bring home a new plane. Devan does target-practice in the DC-4.James builds a Buffalo-style soapbox racer.

programme.title: Ice Pilots NWT: Air Show
programme.desc: Joe flies with the Snowbirds during the Hamilton air show and later teaches Mikey to fly. A surprise departure shakes up Buffalo.

programme.title: Ice Pilots NWT: Five Seasons
programme.desc: Ice Pilots NWT celebrates a milestone with a look back at the last five years, a peek behind the camera and reflections from the Buffalo crew.

programme.title: The Drew Barrymore Show: Ike Barinholtz, Drew's News with Ally Love
programme.desc: "History of the World Part Two" StarIke Barinholtz is joins Drew and talks about how he met his wife in Las Vegas, his new show and more. Peloton Instructor Ally Love joins Drew and Ross Mathews at the Drew's News desk to serve the news sunny-side up.

programme.title: The Drew Barrymore Show: Kiera Knightley, Carrie Coon, Drew's News
programme.desc: Kiera Knightley and Carrie Coon join Drew to talk about their upcoming film, "Boston Strangler."Drew and her co-pilotRoss Mathews are serving the news sunny-side up in an all new Drew's News.

programme.title: The Drew Barrymore Show: Justice Smith, Drew's News with Ali Landry
programme.desc: Actor Justice Smith joins Drew and he's dishing about his latest film, "Dungeons and Dragons." Drew and Ross Mathews are joined by Ali Landry at the Drew's News desk as they serve the news sunny-side up.

programme.title: The Drew Barrymore Show: Lucy Liu, Drew's News
programme.desc: Drew is joined by her friend "Shazam! Fury of the Gods" star Lucy Liu and she's dishing on some of her iconic roles like "Charlie's Angels" and "Kill Bill."

programme.title: The Drew Barrymore Show: Drew's News with Rob Riggle
programme.desc: Rob Riggle joins Drew and Ross Mathews at the news desk to cover topics like the news of a potential "Dumb and Dumber 3" and the couple that opted for mashed potato powder instead of rice at their wedding.

programme.title: The Drew Barrymore Show: Jennette McCurdy
programme.desc: Jennette McCurdy, author of the best-selling memoir, "I'm Glad My Mom Died," has a very honest and revealing conversation with Drew.

programme.title: The Drew Barrymore Show: Phoebe Robinson, Design Under $30, National Teacher’s Day
programme.desc: Podcast host Phoebe Robinson joins Drew to help solve some dilemmas in “Drew’s and Don’ts.” Comedian Michelle Collins and Drew play “Change My Mind: Reality TV Edition.” Drew celebrates Nat'l Teacher’s Day with Bronx middle school teacher Jamel Holmes.

programme.title: The Drew Barrymore Show: James Corden, “Drew’s Love Bug” Dating Apps, The Weekender
programme.desc: James Corden gets candid on hosting a daily show. Drew dives into the world of dating apps enlisting a dating expert to share tips in the latest installment of “Drew’s Love Bug.” Drew gives a curated list of her favorite picks in “The Weekender.”

programme.title: The Drew Barrymore Show: Joe Manganiello, Adam Sandler, Money Talk with Carmen Rita Wong
programme.desc: "Archenemy" star Joe Manganiello chats with Drew. Drew shares some never before seen moments from her chat with Adam Sandler. Personal finance expert Carmen Rita Wong shares tips. Drew tries out some weird food combos with TikTok star Eitan Bernath.

programme.title: 48 Hours: Live to Tell: Trafficked
programme.desc: An examination of sex trafficking through the eyes of survivor Alyssa Beck and the vast array of people who tried to help her – from law enforcement and her family, to the legal system and child advocates.

programme.title: 48 Hours: What Happened in Apartment 4C?
programme.desc: A report on the 2016 disappearance and murder of Joey Comunale after a night of partying in New York City. While out clubbing, Comunale accepted an invitation to a party at a Sutton Place apartment with people he had just met.

programme.title: 48 Hours: Private Needham's War
programme.desc: A report on the case of Pvt. John Needham, a decorated soldier diagnosed with traumatic brain injury and PTSD, and investigators say beat his 19-year-old girlfriend Jacque Villagomez to death with his bare hands in September 2008.

programme.title: 48 Hours: Don't Scream
programme.desc: An investigation on Tiffany Mead of Davis County, Utah, a young mother who called 911 claiming she had sliced her own throat while her ex-husband and child watched.

programme.title: 48 Hours: FindJodi!
programme.desc: A report on new information in the search for Iowa television anchor Jodi Huisentruit, who disappeared on her way to work on June 27, 1995.

programme.title: 48 Hours: The Lost Boy
programme.desc: A report on the 1979 disappearance of Etan Patz, a 6-year-old New York City boy who was allowed to walk to the school bus stop just two blocks from his home; and the case against Pedro Hernandez, the man charged in 2012 with killing him.

programme.title: COPS: Dyed in the Wool
programme.desc: A suspect selling narcotics takes off on foot. A bank robber leaves his wallet in an abandoned money bag. Multiple domestic violence calls end in arrests.

programme.title: COPS: The House Always Wins
programme.desc: A suspect runs from an illegal gambling game claiming shots were fired. A man is caught trespassing on school grounds. A male driver wearing a halter top is pulled over for a minor traffic violation.

programme.title: COPS: Allergy Season
programme.desc: A drunk driver rams into a pursuing police car. A man on a bike flees an area known for drug activity on a bike. A sniffling man attempts to hide a baggie with narcotics under his shirt.

programme.title: COPS: Yard Work
programme.desc: Deputies respond to a call of a man shooting a gun in his front yard. Officers are called to a domestic dispute over an wrinkly infant's shirt. Four armed and suspicious men are spotted by deputies.

programme.title: COPS: Keep it Down!
programme.desc: An officer is forced to subdue a suspect with his baton. A man asks deputies to give him back his drugs before taking him to jail. A man causes a disturbance at an apartment complex.

programme.title: COPS: Hot Potato
programme.desc: A man tosses his stash after being pulled over. Officers question two men in a fight who live with the same woman. A man says his shorts are from a thrift store after drugs are found in them.

programme.title: COPS: Nerves of Noodles
programme.desc: A man tells deputies the pants he has on aren't his. Officers are called to the scene of men firing an ak-47. A nervous driver fesses up to the deputy who stopped him.

programme.title: COPS: What's Your Deductible?
programme.desc: Detectives chase a suspect who wrecks his car. Police are called when a man headbutts his neighbor. Officers tend to a woman punched in the face by her husband while on the bus.

programme.title: COPS: Wardrobe Malfunction
programme.desc: A suspect flees police in a truck over a misdemeanor traffic warrant. A man denies hitting his wife who has a bloody nose. A man denies ownership of his shorts when deputies find drugs in them.

programme.title: COPS: High Speed Golf
programme.desc: Deputies pursue a truck with a trailer full of golf carts. Police question a driver after finding a mask and handgun in his car. Officers are called to a traffic collision involving a semi and an SUV.

programme.title: Crime Scene Solvers: Crime Scene Solvers: A Very Strange Suicide (Muller case)
programme.desc: Police in Strasbourg receive a startling emergency call from Doctor Jean-Louis Muller, a forensic pathologist well known in the region.

programme.title: Crime Scene Solvers: Françoise Desnoue Case
programme.desc: On the evening of August 30st 2013, in a small village of Bougrogne, Éric Desnoue, 52 years old, reports his wife missing to the police. Did Françoise Desnoue run away? Or did she reattempt to kill herself?

programme.title: Crime Scene Solvers: Sylvie Darcy Case
programme.desc: On February 26th 2012, in the Yevelines. Around 11PM policemen are called for an assault in a parking lot in the forest of Saint-Lambet-des-Bois.

programme.title: Crime Scene Solvers: Two Accused of Murder (Jennifer Charron Case)
programme.desc: On Sunday, April 29, 2007, the body of Jennifer Charron, 21-years old, was found burnt to a crisp in a forest near Royan. The young waitress, who had been missing for two days, was visibly beaten and tied up.

programme.title: Crime Scene Solvers: Josiane Bézard Case
programme.desc: On the morning of January 9th 2014, Josiane Bézard, 53 years old, drives her son to the Manosque's train station, and then vanishes.

programme.title: Svenska fall: Avsnitt 604
programme.desc: En 33-årig man hittas ihjälskjuten nära Sundsvall. Det visar sig vara en man som har skaffat sig många fiender och polisen listar i början av utredningen ett femtiotal personer med möjliga motiv.

programme.title: I huvudet på en gärningsman: Avsnitt 204
programme.desc: En kvinna ringer till SOS om att hennes sambo plötsligt blivit sjuk, varpå han körs akut till sjukhus. Det kommer visa sig att hon försökt giftmörda sin sambo - och det är inte heller första gången.

programme.title: Svenska fall
programme.desc: En försommardag 2017 anmäler en mamma att hennes dotter Tova är försvunnen. En stor polisinsats inleds, och efter någon dag hittar man Tovas kropp, fastsurrad i en skottkärra som sänkts i en sjö.

programme.title: Norska Fall: Avsnitt 305
programme.desc: Den 19 december 1994 klev Bjørn Thore Langemyhr på ett tåg från Tønsberg till Oslo. Det är det sista familjen ser av honom. När han inte dyker upp hemma på julafton slår familjen larm.

programme.title: Svenska fall
programme.desc: På en åker utanför Enköping hittas en ung man död. Vid första anblicken ser det ut som om han lagt sig ner för att vila – men när polisen granskar kroppen upptäcker de vad som tros vara en skottskada.

programme.title: Efterlyst
programme.desc: Efterlyst är i Linköping och hjälper polisen att klara upp en misshandel som ägde rum utanför en studentpub. Vi får även se övervakningsfilmen från det hatbrott som drabbade RFSL Sjuhärad i Borås.

programme.title: Efterlyst
programme.desc: I somras blev en ung tjej attackerad av sin expojkvän och hans kompisar på Strandvägen. Vi besöker också Cornell Bailey, som fått sin foodtruck i centrala Sundbyberg vandaliserad i ett års tid.

programme.title: Efterlyst
programme.desc: En sällsynt stor våg av inbrott på byggarbetsplatser har drabbat de östra delarna av Svealand sedan början av februari. Efterlyst uppmärksammar att det på lördag är 40 år sedan mordet på Olof Palme.

programme.title: Efterlyst
programme.desc: Polisen har bett Efterlyst om hjälp kring en grov misshandel som filmades av ett gäng och att ta fast en vapenkurir. Dessutom presenteras den första nomineringen till årets Civilkuragepris.

programme.title: Efterlyst
programme.desc: Efterlyst fortsätter att hjälpa polisen i Stockholm att klara upp avrättningen på 74-årige Curre Sederström. Dessutom konfronteras AI-bedragare som lurar desperata hundägare med krav på lösensumma.
